walkable.note: Island and all eight broad tread silhouettes are subtracted from water. Solid lighthouse footprint still blocks the island centre. Leave a clear walk loop around the lighthouse.

collisionContract.water: Append waterRegions to BOTH world.water and walk-world.water. Every record is a simple poly, no holes or precedence overrides required. Geometry is sampled in 4-unit bands, max 4 world-unit boundary error. Current geometry adds 20 units around water and 16 around obstacles.
collisionContract.solids: Append solidFootprints to BOTH world.obstacles and walk-world.obstacles; never use full sprite bounds.
collisionContract.steppingAccess: The wide tread silhouettes overlap. Use the supplied actual-game geometry check in validation.json; the route remains connected after the engine water padding.
collisionContract.boats: Decorative closed pool only; do not add to boatWater or sea navigation. Boats, wakes and reeds have no solid footprint.

integrationNotes: No repository files changed. Asset handoff only.
Keep existing surrounding trees, globe plaza, stalls, paths and moats. Remove superseded meadow ground flowers inside the pool and move the listed existing props before placement.
All floorTiles, ripples, treads, rim, island grass and shared shadows render below every duck. No upright base slab, no raised platform.
Uprights sort by fixed world sortY. Use explicit width, height, anchor, scale. Lighthouse is one depth group with its base at the island.
Do not use engine shadows for these props: each grounded object already has one footprint shadow in contact-shadows-floor.svg.
Boat hulls are separate SVGs. Apply supplied slow bob to each hull only; leave wakes fixed on floor, no drifting across pool bounds. Static pose under reduced motion.
check.png is a static composition of vector pieces, not a live-game screenshot. No image assets are used in any game SVG.
